```{r setup-mascot_placement, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_placement-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_placement")
```

### Placement

A default mascot() floats in the bottom-right corner. Inline placement puts the mascot where mascot() is
placed in your UI and scrolls with the page. The map shows the four floating corners and the inline option.

```{r mascot_placement-map, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) {
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::tags$p(class = "pg-muted",
      'This studio displays the character inline with placement = "inline" so it remains on the canvas.'),
    shiny::uiOutput("placement_map")
  )
} else guide_placement_map()
```

```r
mascot("helper")
mascot("helper", placement = "inline")
mascot("helper", placement = mascot_placement("top-left", minimise = TRUE))
```

```{r mascot_placement-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_placement", studio_character)
```
